# DriveIT — India's Premier Intercity Expressway Carpool & Rideshare Platform

> DriveIT is an intercity highway rideshare and carpooling platform connecting verified private vehicle owners ("Pilots") with verified commuters ("Passengers") along major Indian highway corridors. It operates strictly under a non-commercial cost-sharing charter pursuant to Section 66 of the Indian Motor Vehicles Act.

## Key Facts & Architecture
- **Website**: https://driveit.in
- **Operating Model**: Non-commercial direct cost-sharing (fuel/energy + NHAI FASTag expressway tolls with zero commercial taxi surge).
- **Core Corridors**:
  - Mumbai ⇄ Pune Expressway (148 km, typical travel time 2.5–3.0 hrs, typical fare ₹350–₹390 per seat).
  - Bengaluru ⇄ Chennai Expressway (340 km, typical travel time 5.0–5.5 hrs, typical fare ₹650–₹750 per seat).
  - Delhi NCR ⇄ Jaipur Highway (280 km, typical travel time 4.0–4.5 hrs, typical fare ₹550–₹620 per seat).
  - Hyderabad ⇄ Vijayawada Corridor (275 km, typical travel time 4.0–4.5 hrs, typical fare ₹520–₹590 per seat).
- **Safety & Verification**:
  - Government UIDAI Aadhaar verification via DigiLocker OAuth2 and Surepass Sub-AUA (Verhoeff checksum validation).
  - 4-digit encrypted Boarding Pass PIN and digital QR pass required before trip initiation.
  - 1-Active-Trip Rule enforcing passenger integrity and eliminating ghost bookings.
- **Eco Incentives**:
  - 10% Green EV fare discount bonus for electric vehicles (Tata Nexon EV, MG ZS EV, Mahindra XUV400).
- **Statutory Compliance**:
  - Compliant with Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.
  - Designated Grievance Redressal Officer under Rule 3(2) of Information Technology Rules 2021 (SLA: 24h ack, 15 days resolution; contact: grievance@driveit.in).
